caption:
OpenAI has released the System Card for Operator, its autonomous web browsing agent. As AI evolves from answering prompts to taking actions on real websites, security risks fundamentally change. Prompt injection is no longer just about offensive text—it can become an unauthorized command execution. OpenAI details a multi-layered defensive strategy combining model mitigations, product boundaries, and external red teaming. Swipe through for the breakdown of how agent safety is changing forever.

Source: OpenAI System Card (https://openai.com/index/operator-system-card)

alt_text_overall: A 7-slide GetByteRush carousel detailing OpenAI's System Card release for Operator and its multi-layered autonomous agent security framework.
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN AI CONTROLS YOUR BROWSER?. OpenAI just released the System Card for Operator, revealing how they evaluate and protect autonomous agents. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: PROMPTS ARE NOW ACTIONABLE.. When an AI agent navigates real websites, web text can trick the model into executing unauthorized commands. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 3: MULTI-LAYERED DEFENSE.. OpenAI details model and product mitigations designed specifically to resist prompt engineering and jailbreak attempts. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 4: EXTERNAL RED TEAM TESTING.. Before release, third-party security teams conducted evaluation passes to probe privacy boundaries and failure modes. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 5: THE AGENT SECURITY PARADIGM HAS SHIFTED.. Chatbot guardrails prevented bad text responses. Agent guardrails must prevent unauthorized physical or digital actions. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 6: PRIVACY AND SECURITY BY DEFAULT.. As agentic workflows scale, system cards and red teaming benchmarks will define which autonomous agents are safe to deploy. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 7: THE ERA OF AUTONOMOUS AGENTS IS HERE.. Security is no longer a post-launch patch—it is the core foundation of autonomous agent architecture. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.
